highlights.title: Pause a project in one click
highlights.line: A Pause button now sits beside the name on each project's page. A paused project says so there and on its card.

highlights.title: Pick the model when you switch provider
highlights.line: Switching an agent to Claude or OpenAI now lets you pick its model in the same step, with one restart.

highlights.title: Move a project's folder
highlights.line: If you moved a project's folder, its settings now ask where it is, and Kosmos uses it from there.

highlights.title: A steadier top bar
highlights.line: On a computer that always shows scrollbars, the top bar no longer jumps when you switch between Separate tabs and One screen.

highlights.title: Codex agents in their own space
highlights.line: From their next start, Codex agents run with their own settings, so the plugins and settings of your own Codex app no longer reach them.
